rationale: The article is entirely off-topic (E01), addressing federal research-to-practice collaboration for community-based long-term health/social services and supports at the nexus of aging and disability ("federal infrastructure" refers to research translation coordination, not water or sanitation infrastructure). It also lacks empirical data and any water/sanitation access outcome.
plain_vs_narrow_note: Excluded under both readings as an off-topic policy commentary on aging and disability long-term services and supports with no connection to water or sanitation service access.

evidence_quotes.quote: Accelerating the Translation of Research into Practice in Long Term Services and Supports: A Critical Need for Federal Infrastructure at the Nexus of Aging and Disability
This article addresses 3 interrelated issues critical to the fields of aging and disability: increasing demand for community-based long-term services and supports
